summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with cleared-by-default thread-entry state (_loop=None, _thread_id=0), set and cleared in the run_app entry point inside try/finally, and invoke() via functools.partial binding plus run_coroutine_threadsafe. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 8 tests covering not-running, same-thread, widget access, awaitable, timeout exception propagation, variadic and keyword forwarding, and call after stop. All 8 pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at this repo's src, because the shared venv's editable install points at another checkout (tasks/.../base/src); the venv was not modified. Six existing async tests fail in the venv with "async def functions are not natively supported" (missing async pytest plugin), unrelated to this change. Nothing committed.
